entries.title: James 4:1
segments: From where do wars and fightings among you [come]? [Is it] not from this, from your lusts which war in your members?

entries.title: James 4:2
segments: You desire, and do not have. You murder, and are jealous, and cannot obtain. You fight and war, yet you have not because you ask not.

entries.title: James 4:3
segments: You ask and receive not, because you ask amiss, that you may spend [it] upon your lusts.

entries.title: James 4:4
segments: Adulterers and adulteresses! Do you not know that the friendship of the world is enmity [with] God? Therefore whoever desires to be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.

entries.title: James 4:5
segments: Do you think that the Scripture says in vain, The spirit that dwells in us yearns to envy?

entries.title: James 4:6
segments: But He gives more grace. Therefore He says, God resists the proud, but He gives grace to the humble.

entries.title: James 4:7
segments: Therefore submit yourselves to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

entries.title: James 4:8
segments: Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse [your] hands, sinners; and purify your hearts, double-minded ones.

entries.title: James 4:9
segments: Be afflicted, and mourn and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and [your] joy to heaviness.

entries.title: James 4:10
segments: Be humbled before the Lord, and He will lift you up.

entries.title: James 4:11
segments: Do not speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against [his] brother, and who judges his brother, speaks against the Law and judges the Law. But if you judge the Law, you are not a doer of the Law, but a judge.

entries.title: James 4:12
segments: There is one Lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. Who are you who judges another?

entries.title: James 4:13
segments: Come now, those saying, Today or tomorrow we will go into such a city and spend a year there, and we will trade and will make a profit,

entries.title: James 4:14
segments: who do not know of the morrow. For what [is] your life? For it is a vapor, which appears for a little time, and then disappears.

entries.title: James 4:15
segments: Instead of you saying, If the Lord wills, we shall live and do this or that.

entries.title: James 4:16
segments: But now you boast in your presumptions. All such boasting is evil.

entries.title: James 4:17
segments: Therefore to him who knows to do good, and does not do [it], to him it is sin.
